# Microsoft 365
> Microsoft 365 provides productivity apps, cloud services, collaboration tools, and AI features for individuals, businesses, education, and enterprises.

Microsoft 365, formerly Office 365, combines apps like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and Copilot with subscription plans tailored for home, business, school, and enterprise use.

## Home and Overview
- [Microsoft 365 Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365): Main Microsoft 365 landing page for subscriptions, apps, cloud services, and AI features.
- [Explore Microsoft 365 for Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/explore-microsoft-365-for-home): Overview of Microsoft 365 benefits, apps, storage, and family-oriented features.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Collaboration and group chat product page for meetings, messaging, and teamwork.
- [Meet Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365-copilot): Introduction to Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI-powered productivity experiences.

## Personal and Family Plans
- [Compare Microsoft 365 Products](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/buy/compare-all-microsoft-365-products): Compare personal Microsoft 365 plans, features, pricing, and included applications.
- [Microsoft 365 Family](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-family/cfq7ttc0k5dm): Family subscription plan with shared benefits, apps, and cloud storage.
- [Microsoft 365 Personal](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkID=2281590): Single-user subscription plan for premium Office apps and cloud services.
- [Microsoft 365 Premium](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/p/microsoft-365-premium/cfq7ttc11z3q): Premium consumer plan with advanced productivity, security, and AI capabilities.

## Business Plans
- [Microsoft 365 for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/business): Small business overview for Microsoft 365 apps, collaboration, and security tools.
- [Business Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/business/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Compare Microsoft 365 business subscriptions, pricing tiers, and included services.
- [Microsoft Teams for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Teams collaboration capabilities relevant to business communication and meetings.

## Enterprise and Frontline
- [Microsoft 365 Enterprise](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/microsoft-365-enterprise): Enterprise overview covering productivity, security, compliance, and management capabilities.
- [Enterprise Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/enterprise/microsoft-365-plans-and-pricing): Compare enterprise subscription plans, licensing options, and feature sets.
- [Frontline Workers](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/enterprise/frontline): Microsoft 365 solutions designed for frontline employees and distributed workforces.
- [Nonprofit Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/enterprise/nonprofit-plans-and-pricing): Pricing and plan information for nonprofit organizations using Microsoft 365.

## Education
- [Microsoft 365 for Students](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/education/students): Student-focused Microsoft 365 offerings, eligibility, and education productivity tools.
- [Microsoft 365 for Schools](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/education/products/microsoft-365): Education product overview for schools, classrooms, and academic institutions.

## Copilot and AI
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365-copilot): AI assistant overview for work, productivity, and Microsoft 365 applications.
- [Copilot Chat](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365-copilot/chat): Chat-based Copilot experience for asking questions, drafting, and summarizing content.
- [AI Agents](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365-copilot/agents): Information about AI agents and task automation within Microsoft 365 Copilot.
- [Daily Prompt Guide](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365-copilot/learn-copilot-today): Prompting guide with examples for learning how to use Copilot effectively.
- [Copilot Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing): Pricing details for Microsoft 365 Copilot plans and licensing options.
